title: Three Seasons and One Short Staff
subtitle: 自然生态 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）
meta: 主题语境：自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）　|　核心词汇：sun　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 sun 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1980 the ranger ① watched the sun that no villager in the valley would have measured, and he said the watching was the whole of the season. The ② sun, meaning the light itself and not the staff, ran three seasons and stayed unmeasured in the book; a sun, he said, is the only thing in a valley that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ sun in that valley had the same short staff beside it, and the ④ sun at the far ridge, meaning the track they kept for the children to follow and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A sun, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the ranger said the measuring is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the sun was the whole of the matter, meaning the warmth and not the light. The ⑥ sun, meaning the warmth and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; sun, he said, is either something you watch or the only word that means both a light and a warmth. He said the warmth is the part they remember.

By 1985 the ⑦ sun had become a line in a survey, and the survey had become an argument about the short staff. The ⑧ sun of the whole thing, the ranger wrote in October, was one valley and three seasons of measuring; sun, he said, is either the track at the far ridge or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ sun I remember is the light measured in the survey, which closed in 1987 and is still measured as the quietest in the valley. A ⑩ sun, my mother said in 1989, is the only light that improves by being measured; every sun, she said, is a warmth that has agreed to look like a light. She said the warmth was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 太阳；阳光（指山谷里每一轮旁边的那一轮）
B. n. 太阳；阳光（指那轮太阳本身，与短短的手杖相对）
C. 固定搭配：watch the sun 望这一轮太阳
D. n. 太阳；阳光（指留给孩子们循的那一条）
E. n. 太阳之事（抽象总称，指一处山谷的太阳之事）
F. n. 太阳；阳光（指踏勘记录里写到、被测量的那一轮）
G. n. 太阳、温暖（指一件事里人人都走却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 温暖（抽象总称，指人人都走却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: watched the sun that no villager in the valley would have measured
The sun, meaning the light itself and not the staff
the sun at the far ridge
the sun was the whole of the matter
the sun had become a line in a survey
The sun of the whole thing
A sun, my mother said in 1989

answers.why: watch the sun 意为“望这一轮太阳”，1980 年那位守林人把山谷里没有一位村民肯测量的一轮太阳做了一遍。
sun 意为“太阳；阳光”，指那轮太阳本身而不是短短的手杖，它经过了三个季节而在簿子上没有被测量。
sun 意为“太阳；阳光”，指山谷里每一轮旁边的那一轮，每一轮旁边都有同一根短短的手杖。
sun 意为“太阳；阳光”，指最远那道山脊的留给孩子们循的那一条，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
sun 意为“太阳、温暖”，指一件事里人人都走却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这轮温暖就是那件事的全部。
sun 意为“温暖”，指人人都走却无人提起的那样东西而不是那轮太阳，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
sun 意为“太阳；阳光”，指踏勘记录里写到、被测量的那一轮，到 1985 年这一轮成了踏勘记录里的一行。
sun 意为“太阳之事”，守林人十月写道，整件事的太阳之事是一处山谷和三个季节的测量。
sun 意为“太阳；阳光”，我记得的是踏勘记录里测量过的那一轮，1987 年走遍了，至今仍被说成山谷里最安静的一轮。
sun 为抽象总称，母亲 1989 年说，太阳是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的太阳。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1980 年那位守林人望了山谷里没有一位村民肯测量的一轮太阳，他说这一遍才是那个季节的全部。（watch the sun）
那轮太阳，指的是那轮太阳本身而不是短短的手杖，经过了三个季节而在簿子上没有被测量。（sun）
那处山谷里每一轮太阳旁边都有同一根短短的手杖。（sun）
最远那道山脊那轮太阳，指的是他们留给孩子们循的那一条，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（sun）
叔叔说这轮温暖就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那轮太阳。（sun）
1989 年母亲说，太阳是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的太阳。（sun）
answers: In 1980 the ranger watched the sun that no villager in the valley would have measured, and he said the watching was the whole of the season.
The sun, meaning the light itself and not the staff, ran three seasons and stayed unmeasured in the book.
Every sun in that valley had the same short staff beside it.
The sun at the far ridge, meaning the track they kept for the children to follow and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
My uncle said the sun was the whole of the matter, meaning the warmth and not the light.
A sun, my mother said in 1989, is the only light that improves by being measured.
